Population in Germany by age group and gender

Population in Germany by age group and gender. Displayed in a grouped bar chart with total in Python and R. Finally, this is displayed in an animation for the period 2014–2024 using gganimate in R.

unify the values and rename the column names

Colum Stichtag:
31.12.2014 -> 2014
31.12.2021 -> 2021 …
Column Altersjahre:
unter 1 Jahr -> 1
36-Jährige -> 36
90 Jahre und mehr -> 90 …

Code 
# display data
from IPython.display import display, Markdown, HTML

# col "Stichtag" = 31.12.2014 -> 2014 ...
data["Stichtag"] = data["Stichtag"].apply(lambda x: x[6:])
# col "Altersjahre" = unter 1 Jahr -> 1-Jährige
# col "Altersjahre" = 90 Jahre und mehr -> 90-Jährige
dict = {"unter 1 Jahr":"1-Jährige", "90 Jahre und mehr":"90-Jährige"}
data["Altersjahre"] = data["Altersjahre"].replace(dict)
# col "Altersjahre" = split only numbers
data["Altersjahre"] = data["Altersjahre"].str.split("-").str[0]

group data (column = age) into categories

Code 
# remove column bundesland
df = data.drop("bundesland", axis = 1)
# group by year, age, sum by bundesland
df = df.groupby(["year", "age"], as_index =False).sum()

bins = [0,  17, 59, 90]
lbls_gr = ["0-17", "18-59", "60+" ]

age_gr = df.groupby("year")[["age"]].transform(lambda x: pd.cut(x, bins = bins, labels = lbls_gr).astype(str))

df["age_grouped"] = age_gr

df.head()

Data Visualizing

Prepare data

Code 
# pivot to long
df_py_pv = pd.melt(
  df_py,                                         # data                           
  id_vars = ["year", "age_grouped", "age_cat"],  # not to shape
  value_vars = ["male", "female"],               # to shape
  var_name = "gender",                           # colname for reshaped vars
  value_name = "cnts"                            # colname for reshaped values
)
# round colum cnts
df_py_pv["cnts"] = df_py_pv["cnts"].map(lambda x: round(x/1000000,2))
# remove colum year
df_py_pv = df_py_pv[df_py_pv["year"] == "2024"].drop("year", axis = 1)

# ordered categories (levels in R)
agegroup = ["0-17", "18-59", "60+"]
agecat = ["Kids & Jugend", "Erwachsene", "Senioren"]
df_py_pv["age_grouped"] = pd.Categorical(df_py_pv["age_grouped"], categories = agegroup, ordered = True)
df_py_pv["age_cat"] = pd.Categorical(df_py_pv["age_cat"], categories = agecat, ordered = True)

# sort
df_py_pl = df_py_pv.sort_values(["age_cat", "cnts"], ascending=[True, False])

df_py_pv.head()
#>    age_grouped        age_cat  gender   cnts
#> 30        0-17  Kids & Jugend    male   7.18
#> 31       18-59     Erwachsene    male  22.47
#> 32         60+       Senioren    male  11.59
#> 63        0-17  Kids & Jugend  female   6.79
#> 64       18-59     Erwachsene  female  21.64

Plotting data frame

Code 
# load moduls
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from highlight_text import fig_text

# pivot
pivot_df = df_py_pl.pivot(index="age_cat", columns="gender", values="cnts")
# totals for eag category
totals = pivot_df.sum(axis=1)
# for second label (age grouped: 0-17,..)
d = df_py_pl.pivot(index=["age_cat", "age_grouped"], columns="gender", values="cnts")
#d.index[0][1]

# plot
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5))

bar_width = 0.25
x = np.arange(len(pivot_df.index))
colors = ["#E85252", "#6689C6"]

# total bar
ax.bar(x, totals, width=bar_width * 2.5, color="#E0E0E0", zorder=0)

for i, sub_cat in enumerate(pivot_df.columns):
    values = pivot_df[sub_cat]
    ax.bar(
        x + (i - 0.5) * bar_width,
        values,
        width=bar_width,
        zorder=1,
        color=colors[i],
    )
    for j, val in enumerate(values):
        ax.text(
            x[j] + (i - 0.5) * bar_width,
            val + 1,
            f"{val:.2f}M",
            ha="center",
            va="bottom",
            fontsize=8,
        )
for i, total in enumerate(totals):
    ax.text(
        x[i],
        total + 1,
        f"Altersgruppe ({d.index[i][1]})\n{total:.2f}M",
        ha="center",
        va="bottom",
        fontsize=9,
        color="#555555",
    )
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(pivot_df.index)
ax.set_yticks(list(range(0, 51, 10)))
ax.spines[["top", "right", "bottom"]].set_visible(False)
ax.tick_params(axis="x", size=0, pad=10)
ax.tick_params(axis="y", labelsize=8)

fig.text(x=0.091, y=0.91, s="Bevölkerung in Deutschland nach Altersgruppen bei Geschlecht in M=Mln., 2024", size=11)
fig_text(
    x=0.14,
    y=0.89,
    s="<female> <male>",
    highlight_textprops=[
        {"color": colors[0]},
        {"color": colors[1]},
    ],
)

plt.show()
#> <highlight_text.htext.HighlightText object at 0x00000253D2CFB0E0>

Prepare data

Code 
# use pandas dataframe df
df_r <- py$df_py
#unique(df_r$age_cat)
# Ensure age_grouped and age_cat is a factor with the desired order (0-13,14-17,18-59,60+)
df_r$age_grouped <- factor(df_r$age_grouped, levels = c("0-17", "18-59", "60+"))
df_r$age_cat <- factor(
  df_r$age_cat, 
  levels = c("Kids & Jugend", "Erwachsene", "Senioren"))

head(df_r)
#>   year age_grouped       age_cat     male   female
#> 1 2014        0-17 Kids & Jugend  6730760  6381260
#> 2 2014       18-59    Erwachsene 23218843 22624986
#> 3 2014         60+      Senioren  9885854 12355834
#> 4 2015        0-17 Kids & Jugend  6865197  6460480
#> 5 2015       18-59    Erwachsene 23614627 22733146
#> 6 2015         60+      Senioren 10034299 12467935
Code 
# pivot long
mln <- 1000000
df_pv <- 
  df_r|> 
  #pivot_longer(
  #  cols = !c(year, age_grouped, age_cat),
  #  names_to = "gender",
  #  values_to = "cnts"
  #) |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(total = sum(male, female)) |>
  pivot_longer(!c(year, age_grouped, age_cat, total), names_to = "gender", values_to = "cnts") |> 
  mutate(
    total = round(total/mln, digits = 2),
    cnts = round(cnts/mln, digits = 2),
    year = as.integer(year),
    gender = factor(gender, levels = c("female", "male"))
  )
rmarkdown::paged_table(head(df_pv, 10))

Plotting data frame

Code 
gg_plt <- 
  df_pv |> 
  filter(year == 2024) |> 
  ggplot()+ # BEGINN ============================================================================
  # Layer 1: Grey background with total values per agegroup =====================================
  geom_col(
    aes(x = age_cat, y = total/2),  # sonst gibt dopplt wert
    fill = "grey85",
    alpha = 0.8,     
    width = 0.8
    ) +
  # Layer 2: Dodged bars for gender =============================================================
  geom_col(
    aes(x = age_cat, y = cnts, fill = gender),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), # Dodge bars side-by-side
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  # Layer 3: Labels for individual gender bars (Value M) ========================================
  geom_text(
    aes(x = age_cat, y = cnts, 
        label = paste(as.character(round(cnts, digits = 2)), "M"), group = gender),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), # Match dodging of bars
    vjust = -0.5,                           # Position label above the bar
    size = 3.3,                            # Adjust text size
    family = "sans"
  ) +
  # Layer 4: Labels for total age group (Value M) ===============================================
  geom_text(
    #data = filter(gender_total, year == 2024),
    aes(x = age_cat, y = total, label = paste(as.character(round(total, digits = 2)), "M")),
    vjust = -0.8, # Position above the grey bar, adjust vertical position
    size = 3.7,    # Adjust text size
    fontface = "bold",
    family = "sans",
    color = "gray40"
  ) +
  # Layer 5: Labels for agegroup (0-17, ..., 60+) ===============================================
  geom_text(
    aes(x = age_cat, y = total, 
        label = paste("Altersgruppe (", as.character(age_grouped), ")")), # label is character
    vjust = -2.9,          
    size = 4.0, 
    # fontface = "bold", 
    family = "sans",
    color = "gray45"
  ) +
  # Plot-, Axistitle ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
  labs(
    title = "Bevölkerung in Deutschland nach Altersgruppen bei Geschlecht in M = Mln., 2024",
    caption = social_caption,
    x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  # Adjust y-axis limits to provide space for labels above the bars -----------------------------
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, max(df_pv$total) * 1.1), # ~35% extra space at top
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +  # Start y-axis at 0
  # Customize the theme =========================================================================
  theme(
  # Plot Title / Caption Style --------------------------------------------------------------
    plot.title = element_text(
      color = "blue4",
      hjust = 0,                # Left-align title
      face = "bold",            # Bold title text
      size = 14,                # Title font size
      margin = margin(b = 5, t = 5)),  # Margin below title
    plot.caption = ggtext::element_markdown(size=12, hjust = 0.5),
  # Legend Style ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    legend.position = "top",               # Legend at the top
    legend.justification = "left",         # Left-align legend items
    legend.title = element_blank(),        # No legend title
    legend.text = element_text(size = 11), # Legend text size
    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"),     # Size of color keys in legend
    legend.margin = margin(b = -5),        # Reduce space below legend
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "ghostwhite"),
  # Axis line / plot&panel  background ------------------------------------------------------
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "ghostwhite"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "ghostwhite"),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),             # y axis label blank
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),            # - in axis blank
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),            # - in axis blank
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "darkslategray"), 
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x =  element_line(colour = "gray")
  ) # END =====================================================================================
gg_plt

g_anm <-

  transition_states(year, transition_length = 2, state_length = 1, wrap = FALSE)

anmt <- animate(

  duration = 10,
  start_pause = 5,
  end_pause = 5,
  renderer = gifski_renderer())
